design.objective: Provide a project-scoped, independently maintained release calendar with member-authorized CRUD, date-range selection and responsive month presentation.
users: Project members viewing and maintaining their project's release arrangements.

requirements.statement: Keep the release-calendar project tab and existing tab routes usable.
acceptance: Direct and interactive tab navigation load the calendar.

requirements.statement: Persist multiple independent entries with title, inclusive release start date, release end date and remark; equal dates represent one day and active ranges for one project cannot overlap.
acceptance: A cross-month entry is returned from every intersecting month
Every date in the range is marked
A non-overlapping second entry is accepted
counterexample: Only the start date is displayed for a range.
Two active entries cover the same date.

requirements.statement: Authorize project members on the server for calendar reads and writes.
acceptance: Non-members and cross-tenant callers are denied.

requirements.statement: Use a desktop month calendar and mobile date-grouped list with inclusive range expansion.
acceptance: Desktop and required mobile viewports have no page-level horizontal overflow
Cross-month ranges appear in every intersecting month
counterexample: A range disappears from its end month.

requirements.statement: Preserve release-window-inspired project tab styling and theme readability.
acceptance: Existing tabs remain usable and theme-readable.

invariants: Active date ranges for one project do not overlap.
Server-side tenant, membership, entity, optimistic-lock and audit controls apply.
release_start_date <= release_end_date and both endpoints are inclusive.
constraints: Vue 3 and existing Element Plus/UI patterns.
Project system module owns the API and data.

selected_approach.name: Extend the existing project calendar with inclusive date ranges
selected_approach.reason: Keeps the existing project context and authorization while allowing one maintained record to cover multiple calendar days.

alternatives.name: Create one record per day
alternatives.rejected_because: Duplicates title/remark/theme data and makes editing a range error-prone.

alternatives.name: Keep only the start date and render a client-side span
alternatives.rejected_because: Cannot persist or query the end boundary reliably across months.

components.name: ProjectView
components.responsibility: Range form, tab routing, daily expansion and responsive rendering

components.name: ProjectService
components.responsibility: Range validation, overlap query, project authorization and audit

components.name: Flyway migration
components.responsibility: Backfill legacy dates and add range columns/index

interfaces.name: Project release calendar REST API
interfaces.contract: Month-overlap listing and optimistic-lock CRUD using release_start_date/release_end_date.

data_flows.input: Member submits an inclusive date range or selects a month
transitions: Validate membership, tenant and start <= end
Expand each returned range across visible dates
data_flows.output: Authorized entries rendered on every date in the range.

error_handling.behavior: Reject request and keep form open

security: Server-side membership, tenant and entity checks
performance: Load one month at a time
compatibility: Backfill existing single-date rows as same-day ranges
operations: Additive migration and retained records on rollback

verification_strategy.signal: Persisted range CRUD, overlap filtering and denied unauthorized access
verification_strategy.method: Focused service, migration and authenticated API tests.

verification_strategy.signal: Tab navigation, daily range rendering and no overflow
verification_strategy.method: Frontend build and browser checks at desktop and three mobile viewports.

assumptions.text: Project membership continues to grant calendar maintenance authority.
assumptions.basis: Existing approved REQ-081 design and user confirmation.
assumptions.falsifier: Owner specifies an additional role boundary.

decisions.decision: One record stores inclusive release_start_date and release_end_date; equal dates represent a single day.
Every day within the range is marked and the record appears in each intersecting month.
Existing release_date rows are backfilled as same-day ranges by V218.
decisions.reason: Preserve existing data while changing the contract

risks.mitigation: Overlap SQL tests and browser checks for both boundary months.

risks.impact: Migration failure or stale legacy values
risks.mitigation: Add columns, backfill, retain old column and run Flyway checks.

approval.evidence: User confirmed one record with start/end dates and daily marking for the range.

global_constraints: Keep project-member authorization, audit and optimistic locking
Do not touch unrelated REQ-084 changes

file_map.responsibility: Date range columns, backfill and overlap index
file_map.evidence: Approved design revision 2 and updated task scope.
